name: Cross-network hydraulic verifier v4
decision_order: Fit and refine every configured family on training hours.
Retain a family only if both split improvements exceed 0.02.
Retain a family only if its held-out absolute goodness-of-fit is not rejected at alpha 0.05.
If no family remains, return no_fault only when the nominal model passes its held-out goodness-of-fit test; otherwise return unknown_cause.
If exactly one family remains, accept it.
If multiple families remain, compare only those supported families and return ambiguous_causes when the best two are separated by less than 0.07; otherwise accept the best supported family.
network_specific_inputs_that_are_not_dec: EPANET model and valid component identifiers
configured sensor set and flow link
